queries.query: Caoxian China official cadastral parcel map land records GIS
queries.result: Search returned the Ministry of Natural Resources Real Estate Registration Center (RERC) as the national official lead and general Chinese official guidance on cadastral-map access. No Caoxian-specific public map/API or anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was found.

queries.query: 曹县 不动产登记 地籍图 公开 地图 服务
queries.result: Chinese-language discovery returned the national RERC site and general official examples describing county/city registration services, but no verified Caoxian natural-resources viewer, public cadastral layer, or safe anonymous parcel response. A search result labelled 曹县人民政府 was not treated as first-party because its host was not an official government domain.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Real Estate Registration Center, Ministry of Natural Resources, China

officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: The indexed result identifies the national center and a local registration-site directory. It does not expose a Caoxian parcel feature service or anonymous geometry API. Direct fetch failed with a 502 in the web tool and DNS failure in the bounded shell request.
